description: Get everything an issuer account has issued: every credential type, distinct subject count, and acceptance rate. Served from a network-wide census rebuilt on a schedule — the response includes coverage ("complete" or "partial") so a mid-walk answer is never mistaken for a finished count. Params: issuer_address (r..., required). Free, no signup.

issuer_address.description: XRPL classic address of the credential issuer (starts with r)

name: get_issuer_credentials
